==Description==
'''Jack-o-Bot''', internally referred to as '''Jackobot''', was the fourth and final boss of the [[The Haunted Past|second act]] in the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. Being the final boss, it had a very high amount of health, much higher than all other bosses before it, though it walked at an extremely slow pace. As it was a boss enemy, it was immune to being slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], could not be frozen by freezing towers and could only be slowed down by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]]. It was also unable to be affected by the [[Witch (Lunar Overture)|Witch]]'s ability.

'''Jack-o-Bot''' had two abilities. Its first one was ''Hallow Hellraiser'', where '''Jack-o-Bot''' would start firing its right arm machine gun in a sweeping fashion, stunning towers. The second ability was ''Jack-o-Bombs'', in which '''Jack-o-Bot''' would fire between three to six explosive pumpkins at different towers. These pumpkins would explode upon impact, creating green smoke and stunning all towers hit by the explosion.

==Appearance==
'''Jack-o-Bot''' was a giant mechanical pumpkin robot with a pumpkin head (similar to {{RLinkC|17450053|Sinister P}}) and pumpkin shoulders, controlled by an unknown humanoid. On its hands it was armed with a minigun on the right and an explosive pumpkin launcher on the left. In its chest, there was a small cockpit which houses the humanoid controlling '''Jack-o-Bot''', along with two control sticks. It had mechanical legs and treaded feet. The humanoid controlling '''Jack-o-Bot''' had yellow skin, a red torso and blue pants.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Engineer]] and [[Golden Minigunner]] are very effective against '''Jack-o-Bot'''.
**Towers that are immune to stuns, like the [[Pursuit]], are also strong options.
***Cliff towers like the [[Ranger]] are actually able to be stunned by '''Jack-o-Bot'''.
**The [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] can be also helpful at boosting your towers' range and firerate respectively.
*Alongside '''Jack-o-Bot''', hordes of various enemies also spawn, even after it has spawned. Because of this, splash damage towers like the [[Mortar]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be useful at clearing them out.
**After other enemies are cleared out, though, splash damage towers become less effective, as '''Jack-o-Bot''' lacks a summoning ability.
**Placing the [[Accelerator]] further back ensures it does not lock onto '''Jack-o-Bot''' too early and let the other enemies pass.
*The [[Medic]] is quite useful, as it can cleanse your towers from '''Jack-o-Bot's''' stun.
*Because of its immunities, it cannot be frozen by freezing towers or slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]].
**The [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] can only slow it down instead of stunning it.
***It is not necessary to attempt to slow '''Jack-o-Bot''' as it is already an extremely slow enemy.
*Placing expendable towers can be fairly useful to distract '''Jack-o-Bot''' into using its abilities on them instead of your main DPS towers. These towers can be the cheap towers you used for the early game or support towers with unlimited placement limit, like the [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Commander]].

==Trivia==
*The '''Jack-o-Bot''' is a returning boss from the [[Halloween 2019 Event]], despite having a small name difference.
*The '''Jack-o-Bot''' has multiple UGC accessories made based on it, some of which were obtainable by triumphing [[The Haunted Past]].
**There are two accessories that could have been obtained, these being {{RLinkC|15169364528|Jack O' Bot Head}} and {{RLinkC|15169347067|Jack O' Bot Chestplate}}.
**There are also two accessories that were never obtainable, these being {{RLinkC|15169419270|Jack O' Bot Shoulder Cannon}} and {{RLinkC|15169413371|Jack O' Bot Shoulder Minigun}}.
**While '''Jack-o-Bot''' is named and referred to as ''Jack-o-Bot'' in [[The Haunted Past]], its [[Lunar Overture Event#Accessories|UGC accessories]] call it ''Jack O' Bot''.
*The humanoid seen controlling '''Jack-o-Bot''' could be a reference to the [[w:c:boss-fighting-stages-rebirth:Baller (Class)|Baller]] from ''Roblox Boss Fighting Stages''.
*This was the slowest enemy in the game at the time of the [[Lunar Overture Event]].
*'''Jack-o-Bot''' was the only boss that could stun cliff towers after they gained a full [[Stun Immunity]].
**Some other bosses were once able to stun cliff towers, such as the legacy [[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]], but those were unintentional bugs.
